dynamics.y: k * y - alpha * (1.0 if y >= 0.0 else 0.0) + bias + I

extensions.source_equation_note: Nagumo and Sato (1972), DOI 10.1007/BF00290514; reduced equations reproduced in Aihara (1989), RIMS Kokyuroku 710, Eqs. 1-7.
extensions.input_note: I perturbs transformed stimulus a(t); raw A(t) requires the source temporal transform.
extensions.defaults_note: y0=0.1, k=0.6, alpha=1 are Aihara Figure 3 anchors; bias=0.2 is a documented nontrivial default.
